submissions.title: Raleigh OKs 6-Month Data Center Pause As Moratoriums Sweep North Carolina
submissions.excerpt: data centers that are 10K SF or larger and use more than 5 megawatts of electricity
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: Raleigh, NC City Council voted 7-1 on Oct 6, 2026 to approve a 6-month moratorium (reported to run to ~April 2027) on new data center approvals above a 10,000 sq ft / 5 MW threshold, spending the first 2 months studying impacts and the next ~120 days drafting permanent zoning rules (noise/water/air/light). Councilmember Christina Jones cast the lone dissenting vote, arguing 6 months was too short; some residents pushed for a 32-month pause. The moratorium followed developer Beacon Partners withdrawing a ~100,000 sq ft project after local opposition.
